title: ComponentConformanceReceiverEnvironment
description: DD-124(4), 07 §8A: identity of the isolated receiver deployment a plan with receiver_start/receiver_observe steps observes. isolatedCoreBuildId is the PlatformBuildInfo CORE buildId of the isolated Core/Worker and must equal the current production Core build. sourceReleaseId with its artifact and manifest digests names the production Catalog release, APPROVED and declaring read_edge SOURCE or BOTH, that the isolated deployment runs as the source. It is delivered with the isolated identity, fixed by the plan identity digest and copied into the plan; it is not evidence that any step passed.
